# custom_notes (Data Source)

Fetches the list of notes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all notes.
data "custom_notes" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `notes` (Attributes List) List of notes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--notes))

<a id="nestedatt--notes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `notes`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Date and time note was created.
- `id` (String) String uuid identifier of the note.
- `text` (String) Note content.
- `updated_at` (String) Date and time note was last updated.
